capabilities: write with pressure-sensitive pen, highlighter and stroke-cutting eraser
draw, select and edit shapes with a lasso, grouping and locking
import PDFs and write on them as page backgrounds
export notes to PDF with bookmarks and print them
manage notebook pages with thumbnails, sections, titles and version history
extras: Notes are stored in a custom .hnote file format (plus a hidden data folder), not Markdown; the README warns some sync services skip hidden folders, and says the plugin makes no network requests.
motivation: The author was frustrated with existing tools and wanted handwritten notes alongside regular Markdown notes; they vibecoded it due to lack of time and published it knowing there would be bugs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to handwrite notes with a stylus; regular notes are typed Markdown and there is no pen, highlighter or freehand drawing surface.
summary: Handwriting plugin that lets you write notes with a pressure-sensitive pen on styled notebook pages, with shapes, PDF import and PDF export.
